name: data-sets
description: Data commands manage model-space scalar, vector, tensor, and label data. They are useful for imported measurements, interpreted geology, and overlaying external results with FLAC model plots.
notes: Keep units and coordinate system in the data-set name or metadata.
Group imported data immediately so later plots and exports remain selectable.
Use plot data items to confirm imported data align with the model domain.
verification: Scalar vector tensor subcommands (7): create, delete, export, group, import, list, results
data scalar / data vector / data tensor share the identical subcommand set above (live-enumerated, FLAC3D 9.7) — all primary commands in this file confirmed.
'data label' parses positionally (no subcommand enumeration at that slot); its subcommand shapes are not yet curated.
Top-level 'data <bogus>' does not enumerate the type names (scalar/vector/tensor/label) — probe one level down.

keywords.use: Point measurements such as pore pressure, elevation, or material index.
keywords.name: scalar

keywords.use: Directional measurements such as displacement or velocity vectors.
keywords.name: vector

keywords.use: Stress/strain tensor measurements or interpreted tensor fields.
keywords.name: tensor

keywords.use: Text labels for annotations, stations, or named locations.
keywords.name: label

examples.command:
data scalar import 'measurements.csv'
data scalar group 'field-data'

data vector export 'vectors.csv'
data tensor export 'stress_tensor.csv'
